title: Recommended toys
intro: Toys matched to developmental stage, from 0 to 6 years. Fewer toys rotated every 1–2 weeks work better than a full toy box.

sections.title: Toy safety
sections.tip: Check this with every purchase, second-hand included.

items.name: CE marking and compliance with EN 71
Toilet-roll test: anything that fits through the tube is not for children under 3
Button batteries only behind a screw-fastened cover
items.why: A swallowed button battery can seriously damage the oesophagus within 2 hours.

items.name: Strong magnets only for older children
items.why: Two swallowed magnets can attract each other through the intestinal walls.

items.name: No long strings or ribbons near the cot
Black-and-white contrast cards
items.why: A newborn sees strong contrasts best at 20–30 cm.

items.name: Cot mobile
items.why: Remove it when the baby starts sitting up or reaching, usually around 5 months.

items.name: Teethers
items.why: Chilled in the fridge, not frozen.

items.name: Rattles in different shapes and textures
Sturdy push walker (once pulling to stand, around 9–10 months)
Bath toys without holes
items.why: Toys with a hole collect water and mould.

items.name: Bike with or without stabilisers, scooter, helmet
Simple science kits
items.why: From about age 5, with an adult.
